properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 19 at 2:26AM MDT until September 19 at 5:15AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding and debris flows are possible over the Gold
Mountain Burn scar.

* WHERE...Southeastern Ouray County in southwestern Colorado over the
Gold Mountain Burn scar and along Highway 550 from Ouray to
Portland...

* WHEN...Until 515 AM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Excessive rainfall is possible over the Gold Mountain
Burn Scar which could lead to flash flooding and/or debris flows,
particularly along highway 550 between Cutler Creek and Dexter
Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 226 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms may impact
the Gold Mountain burn scar over the next few hours. This could
impact flows through the Cutler and Dexter Creek Drainages.
- Cutler and Dexter Creek Drainages is the most likely place to
experience minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Gold Mountain Burn scar area from Ouray to Portland including
portions of Highway 550.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
